mapper.select:
select p.post_title as postTitle, ps.post_content as postContent, tal.member_id as memberId, tak.search_word as searchWord
from tbl_ai_log tal join tbl_post p on tal.post_id = p.id join tbl_post_section ps on p.id = ps.post_id join tbl_ai_keyword tak on tak.member_id = tal.member_id and p.created_datetime = now() where tal.member_id = #{memberId} order by tal.created_datetime desc limit 5
